description.en: Amphicyon longiramus reconstructed from a skull and separate limb specimens, not one measured individual. Its robust body and tail are species-informed interpretations; coat, ears, muzzle padding, colour, posture and adult size are illustrative, with no mass or proven locomotion claim.
description.zh: 犬熊 Amphicyon longiramus 参考颅骨与不同个体的肢骨复原，并非某个实测个体。粗壮躯体与尾部为结合物种资料的解释；毛被、耳、吻部软组织、颜色、姿态及成年尺寸均为示意，不作体重或已证实运动方式的判断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static refined-low-poly living reconstruction of Amphicyon longiramus. Skull form is informed by UF 162723; separate postcranial specimens inform limb robustness. This is a species-informed composite, not a scan, a replica of one individual, or a proven locomotion reconstruction.

scientific_limits.en: Coat, ears, muzzle padding, colors, exact tail outline and display posture are artistic interpretations. The skull and limb references are different individuals; their sex and dimensions are not combined into a measured individual. Overall size is an illustrative adult envelope, not a mass estimate. A specialist life reconstruction informs broad body/tail interpretation but is not fossil evidence.
scientific_limits.zh: 毛被、耳、吻部软组织、颜色、尾部的精确外形与展示姿态均为美术解释。颅骨与肢骨参考属于不同个体，不能把其性别与尺寸拼接为某个实测个体。整体尺度为示意性成年体型，不作体重估计。专家活体复原仅辅助理解躯干与尾部，不作为化石证据。

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Practical ceiling rather than a target. Aim for roughly 4500–8000 emitted triangles, spending geometry on head profile, coherent shoulder/hip transitions, leg gaps and tail taper. Do not damage identity to meet the preferred range.

taxon.age_context: Early Miocene, approximately 18–16 million years ago
taxon.individual_scope: No sex or exact museum individual asserted for the living reconstruction.

scale.basis: Original plausible adult display dimensions, informed qualitatively by the references; not measured from a mounted skeleton and not a taxonomic maximum. Do not label these as specimen measurements.

pose.description: Quiet four-footed stance, head gently extended forward and near level, mild stagger separating the far legs, broad feet resting on the ground, and a long tapering tail descending then lifting slightly away from the floor. No running, rearing or attack pose.
pose.mouth: Closed or nearly closed; a narrow mouth seam is enough. Do not exaggerate fangs.
pose.interpretation: An original stable exhibit pose, not a documented gait.

morphology.obligation: An elongated low muzzle in front of a distinct cheek/temporal region. Show a gently narrowing snout, a restrained forehead break and a continuous lower jaw; avoid a short round bear face, wolf wedge or toy oversized eyes.
morphology.basis: Museum skull photographs, interpreted with modest original soft tissue.

morphology.obligation: Broad deep trunk, powerful shoulder and thigh transitions, robust limbs, and broad ground-contacting plantigrade feet. Do not use a gracile digitigrade canid stance.
morphology.basis: Museum account and inspected skeletal figures; external flesh is interpretive.

morphology.obligation: Long muscular tail with a broad integrated base and continuous taper, not a bear stump, fluffy fox brush, curled dog tail or lion tuft. Keep the trunk elongated instead of making a spherical bear body.
morphology.basis: Specialist interpretation of Olsen material, not a claim that soft tissue is preserved.

morphology.obligation: At thumbnail size retain the combination of an elongate cranial profile, substantial bear-like torso and limbs, grounded broad feet, and long tail. The result must not read as a recolored bear or dog.
morphology.basis: Original synthesis; no one feature alone is asserted to diagnose the genus.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: Original restrained umber/taupe coat, slightly lighter underside and muzzle, dark nose/eyes/claws. Matte Principled/glTF materials. No fossil color claim.
surface_profile.normal_style: Deliberately faceted or mixed broad planes; no noisy faceting, fur cards, strands or glossy toy finish.

art_direction.construction: Author lofted or sculpted cross-sections with coherent shoulder, neck, hip and tail-base transitions; do not leave visible balls and cylinders as the final organic design.
art_direction.ears: Small subordinate rounded-triangular ears are an original soft-tissue choice, not a scientific diagnostic.
art_direction.feet: Broad low paws with restrained toe segmentation and short dark claws; no fan of detached capsules. Do not claim exact digit anatomy from the selected figures.
art_direction.negative_space: Four legs should remain distinguishable in side/top/perspective; avoid torso/limb wedges, floating feet, deep joint seams and a tail merged with a hindfoot.
excluded_details: display plinth or scenery in export

view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect 3–4 low-cost private clay/silhouette views before final rendering.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of the exact delivered GLB; perspective and preview may be identical bytes.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default. Add only to resolve a concrete observed problem.
view_plan.website_reuse: Current website renderer/camera contract was not verified in prep. Keep standard QA views; do not claim website derivative compatibility or produce extra website images here.

runtime_profile.portability: No external buffers or textures. Pin observed Blender/exporter and Three.js versions in build evidence.

acceptance_obligations: Shape criteria must be visible in the actual exported GLB views, not inferred from names or measurements.
Source geometry/export checks, official Khronos validation, and actual parse/reimport evidence must bind the final GLB hash.
Two isolated deterministic rebuilds must verify declared relative dependency closure and semantic geometry/material equivalence.
Fresh independent visual, factual and specification review must retain actual reviewer identity and evidence. Maker leaves qa/decision.json PENDING.
GPU, populated scene, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN unless separately evidenced; local acceptance is not publication approval.

original_inventory_identity.selection: Species choice follows the inventory taxon-specific Florida Museum lead. No new asset ID or species substitution.
